input.summary: Add mutual carve-outs to the liability caps and remove the blanket exclusion of liability for loss of Customer data
input.comment: [Playbook] The caps are mutual and 12-months-of-charges based, which works for us, but our position requires carve-outs for confidentiality/data protection, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud, and we cannot accept IBM excluding all liability for loss of our records or data in a hosting deal.

ops.oldText: 2. loss of, or damage to, Customer's or any other entity's records or data.
ops.newText: 2. loss of, or damage to, any other entity's records or data. The limitations in Sections 9.1 and 9.2 do not apply to either party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, or its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and IBM remains liable for loss of or damage to Customer's records or data.

input.summary: Fix renewal term at 12 months and shorten the non-renewal notice window to 30 days
input.comment: [Playbook] Renewal terms that mirror a multi-year initial term with a 90-day exit window are outside our position; we need 12-month renewals with a 30-day (fallback 60-day) non-renewal notice.

ops.oldText: for an additional term equal in duration to the previous term of the applicable Service Option Attachment
ops.newText: for an additional term of twelve (12) months

ops.oldText: at least ninety (90) days prior to the end
ops.newText: at least thirty (30) days prior to the end

input.summary: Add a conformance warranty for Materials and Base Components with a re-performance/refund remedy, carved out of the disclaimers
input.comment: [Playbook] IBM warrants only reasonable care and skill, with Materials provided "AS IS" and no remedy; we need at least a 90-day conformance warranty for deliverables with re-performance, repair or refund, carved out of Sections 5.2 and 5.4.

ops.text: IBM further warrants that, for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, each Materials deliverable and the Base Components will conform in all material respects to their applicable documentation and Service Option Attachments. Customer's remedy for breach of the warranties in this Section 5.1 is, at IBM's option, re-performance, repair or replacement, or a refund of the charges paid for the non-conforming Services, Materials or Base Components. The warranties in this Section 5.1 are not limited or disclaimed by Sections 5.2 or 5.4.

input.summary: Remove the at-will revocability of the Base Components licence and extend it to Affiliates and contractors
input.comment: [Playbook] A licence revocable at IBM's discretion, with no coverage for our Affiliates or contractors, is a walk-away for us; the licence should run for the term and be terminable only in accordance with Section 3.3.

ops.oldText: IBM grants Customer a nonexclusive, revocable license to use the Base Components solely in connection with the Services as provided under this Agreement.
ops.newText: IBM grants Customer, its Affiliates and its contractors acting on Customer's behalf a nonexclusive license to use the Base Components solely in connection with the Services as provided under this Agreement, which license IBM may not revoke except upon termination of this Agreement in accordance with Section 3.

input.summary: Insert a Vendor insurance covenant in the general terms
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no insurance obligation even though IBM hosts our environment and processes our data; we require standard CGL, E&O and cyber coverage with certificates on request.

ops.text: 14.12A Insurance. IBM shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by law. IBM shall provide certificates of insurance on Customer's request.

input.summary: Insert transition assistance, data return and deletion obligations on termination
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 3.5 addresses only our payment obligations; we need transition assistance and return of our Content in a machine-readable format, followed by certified deletion.

ops.text: Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for any reason, IBM will (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at IBM's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return all Content and other Customer data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such Content and data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.

input.summary: Cap the early termination charges payable by Customer at three months' charges
input.comment: [Playbook] Early termination charges set solely by Attachment A are open-ended; our position is no liquidated amounts payable by us, with a fallback of a single early-termination fee capped at three months' charges.

ops.oldText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
ops.newText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments, provided that such charges will not exceed, in the aggregate, three (3) months' charges for the terminated Services and will be the only amounts payable by Customer as a result of such termination.
